title: SH-WTP whole-plant C0/C1/C2 control matrix and PI/PID loop contracts (DESIGN FREEZE, synthetic/reference)

control_truth.control_evidence_status: GAP-SHW-002 (PLC source code / interlock matrix unavailable) -> control truth unavailable
control_truth.vendor_equivalence: NOT CLAIMED: no PLC/DCS vendor emulation, no site tuning
control_truth.reusable_contract_vocabulary: configs/model_types/pid_controller_v1.yaml (kp, ki, kd, scan_time_s; ports pv_input/sp_input/output; python_class virtual_factory.control.pid_controller.PIDController)

levels.C0: No active controller. Allowed only for pure source/sink/reference blocks (raw-water boundary, distribution outlet boundary, electrical/automation reference areas).
levels.C1: Functional control: on/off, open/close, basic setpoint logic, permissives/interlocks, duty/standby, timers, simple proportional/rule-based behaviour. Whole-plant target level.
levels.C2: Dynamic PI/PID control for selected important loops inside the deep scopes only.

scopes.note: external raw-water source is a C0 boundary; intake train itself is modelled
T105->T106 adjacency is VF-inferred (see report matrix)

scopes.design_level: C1 (C2 upgrade OPTIONAL, SA awareness item Q3)
scopes.note: in-line position relative to REL-SHW-F01 is PIM-ambiguous; included in deep scope A only with an explicit VF-assumed edge

loops.name: T100 receiving-tank level control
loops.mv: raw-water intake pump speed command [% of rated] (or inlet valve position [%] where the pump is fixed-speed)
loops.output_limits: [pump_min_pct, pump_max_pct] = [0, 100] with a configured minimum-running band; valve variant [0, 100] %
loops.anti_windup: clamping (integral frozen at saturation) + back-calculation on exit; no integral action while MANUAL
loops.auto_manual: AUTO|MANUAL with bumpless transfer (MANUAL output seeded from the last MV)
loops.init_reset: on run start/reset: level = configured initial level; integral = output_initial - kp*error (bumpless); MANUAL output = last commanded speed
interlocks: low-low level (LALL) -> stop intake pump(s)
high-high level (LAHH) -> close inlet / stop pumps
pump fault -> duty pump handover
alarm_thresholds: LAHH / LAH / LAL / LALL on level
loops.synthetic_tuning_status: synthetic_reference (no site tuning, no vendor equivalence claimed)

loops.name: Raw-water intake flow control (LINE1 feed)
loops.sp: flow setpoint [m3/h] (demand/feed-forward from LINE1 requirement, operator/scenario adjustable)
loops.mv: intake pump VFD speed [%] (or inlet control valve [%])
loops.output_limits: [min_speed_pct, 100] % ; flow clamped to pump curve limits
loops.anti_windup: clamping + conditional integration (no integration when the clamped output cannot reduce |error|)
loops.deadband: flow deadband to avoid hunting in the flat region of the pump curve
loops.auto_manual: AUTO|MANUAL, bumpless; MANUAL = direct speed/valve command
loops.init_reset: flow integrator initialised from the measured/commanded steady state at t=0
interlocks: high discharge pressure -> reduce speed
pump dry-run protection -> stop
T100 LAHH -> stop

loops.name: Intake pumping duty/standby + screen management (functional)
loops.sp: target duty configuration (e.g. 1 duty + 1 standby, auto-alternate)
loops.output_limits: n/a (discrete) — minimum run/rest timers bound the transitions
loops.rate_limit: minimum run time / minimum rest time
loops.init_reset: on reset the alternation counter and timers are re-initialised deterministically
interlocks: both pumps faulted -> dependability alarm
screen high differential -> scraper run + alarm

loops.name: T108 clean-water tank level control (transfer/distribution pump)
loops.anti_windup: clamping + back-calculation; integral held while the pump is stopped by an interlock
loops.init_reset: T108 level and pump MV initialised from the configured scenario state (preserves the existing first_order tank semantics on reset)
permissives: T106 effluent quality OK (or bypass permitted)
interlocks: T108 LALL -> stop transfer pump
T108 LAHH -> stop inlet to tank / alarm
pump fault -> standby handover

loops.name: T106 filtration inlet flow control
loops.output_limits: [0, 100] % stroke; effective flow limited by valve authority and available head
loops.deadband: small flow deadband to avoid valve dither
loops.auto_manual: AUTO|MANUAL, bumpless; MANUAL = direct valve position
loops.init_reset: valve position and integrator initialised from the scenario steady state
interlocks: filter DP high-high -> force reduced flow / start backwash
valve fail-closed on loss of control power (fail-safe direction is a VF assumption)

loops.name: Filter backwash sequence + wash-water duty (functional)
loops.pv: filter differential pressure [kPa], filtered turbidity proxy, backwash step state
loops.sp: backwash trigger (DP threshold sustained for a set time, or time-since-last-backwash, or turbidity breakthrough)
loops.mv: backwash pump start/stop, inlet/outlet valve open/close, wash-water routing
loops.output_limits: n/a (discrete); backwash water volume bounded by the wash-water tank level
loops.rate_limit: step timers (valve stroke time, pump ramp, settle time)
loops.auto_manual: AUTO|MANUAL per sequence; MANUAL = step-by-step operator control
loops.init_reset: sequence returns to IDLE and timers/last-backwash clock are re-initialised on reset
permissives: inlet flow below the backwash interlock limit
interlocks: backwash aborted on low wash-water level
high residual turbidity after backwash -> train fault / alarm
wash-water recovery return limited by T110 level

loops.name: T108 outlet / distribution pressure-flow control (boundary loop)
loops.level: C2 (boundary; keep C1 if SA prefers a shallower outlet)
loops.output_limits: [pump_min_pct, 100] %; pressure output clamped to the pump curve
loops.anti_windup: clamping; integral preload on pump start
loops.deadband: pressure deadband (0.05 bar) to avoid hunting
loops.init_reset: pressure loop integrator preloaded from the steady-state pump speed for the scenario
interlocks: T108 LALL -> stop HSP
overpressure -> stop/lower speed
pump fault -> standby handover
loops.synthetic_tuning_status: synthetic_reference; the T108 -> DIST-P108 relation itself is VF-assumed (PIM has not established the unit-level relation or endpoint)

loops.name: Aeration contact tank residence control (functional)
loops.sp: minimum residence time (rule) and level band
loops.mv: inlet/outlet valve positions (on/off or % where modelled)
loops.init_reset: deterministic initial level/valve state per scenario
interlocks: high/low level -> inhibit the downstream feed

loops.name: Coagulant / PAC dose ratio control (flow-proportional + trim)
loops.level: C1 (C2 trim OPTIONAL, SA awareness item Q3)
loops.sp: target dose ratio [mg/L] (scenario/operator; the dose-quality relation is a VF hypothesis)
loops.controller: ratio control (C1) with optional proportional trim
loops.output_limits: [0, 100] % stroke; absolute dose clamped to a plausible band
loops.anti_windup: n/a for ratio; trim integrator (if enabled) clamped
loops.deadband: dose deadband to avoid pump chatter
loops.rate_limit: dose ramp limited to avoid shock dosing
loops.init_reset: dose ratio initialised from the scenario definition
interlocks: chemical tank low-low -> stop dosing + alarm (water quality risk)
overdose guard -> reduce/stop

loops.name: Clarifier sludge withdrawal (functional)
loops.pv: sludge blanket level proxy / sludge pump run time
interlocks: sludge line high pressure -> stop pump

loops.name: Chlorine residual / CT compliance control (functional)
loops.level: C1 (C2 upgrade OPTIONAL, SA awareness item Q3)
loops.sp: residual setpoint band with a CT minimum (compliance proxy)
loops.output_limits: [0, 100] % stroke, dose clamped to a plausible band
loops.anti_windup: n/a for proportional; if C2 trim is enabled, clamped integral
interlocks: residual < minimum -> quality alarm (not a plant trip)
overdose guard
loops.synthetic_tuning_status: synthetic_reference; T107 in-line position is PIM-ambiguous (VF-assumed edge)

loops.name: Sludge treatment sink duty cycle (functional)
interlocks: high-high level -> alarm and inhibit upstream withdrawal

plant_wide_rules.single_run_authority: All loops and sequences execute inside the ONE canonical SH-WTP RuntimeSession; no loop owns a session/run authority.
plant_wide_rules.control_separation: Process Model <-> Controller Model <-> Actuator Model must stay separate objects (actuator slew/limits per configs/model_types/*_actuator_v1.yaml vocabulary).
plant_wide_rules.saturation_and_modes: Every C2 loop defines output limits, anti-windup, deadband/rate limits, AUTO/MANUAL with bumpless transfer and deterministic init/reset.
plant_wide_rules.interlock_philosophy: Interlocks are VF synthetic permissive/trip rules; they must be labelled synthetic_reference and must never be presented as site logic (GAP-SHW-002).
plant_wide_rules.fidelity_labels: Every scope/loop carries a fidelity label from the existing vocabulary (logical_only | synthetic_reference | first_order) plus provenance simulation/synthetic.
plant_wide_rules.no_new_vocabulary: No new control/fidelity vocabulary is introduced by X0; existing enums and model-type contracts are reused.
